@everyone 

We are excited to be so close to finally launching the mint of our Bubblejett Sprinter OG Custom. As you all know, these are free NFTs that will be given to OG members of our discord server. It's our way of saying thank you for being with us since the beginning, and also continually showing support for our project! 

This isn't just another NFT mint... this is also a huge step forward as our custom marketplace will be utilized for this mint! We have been meticulously developing this marketplace for months.

At the moment, our OGs are slowly [clears throat] creating their accounts and verifying their discord accounts on our marketplace. This does a few things... 

1 -  No matter what happens, we will always be able to provide support to someone that has made a transaction in our marketplace. Because we can see the order status of someone and have the freedom to directly communicate with them through discord, our level of support is now premium. 
2 - Having to validate your account via discord will massively slow down bot attempts. And not to mention we can control every sale be restricting them to certain discord roles. So, in the majority of cases, if you don't have a discord role, you can't access our sales.

We will be announcing the official mint date very soon!

Cornucopians.... It's time for a community update!

@everyone

OGs! The sale (free mint) will take place on Monday at 3PM UTC! Here is how things will work… 

Starting Monday, OGs will have 2 weeks to mint their NFT. We will be releasing the NFT in batches of 100 until all OGs have minted or until we have reached the 2 week cut off date. We will have a max supply 1400 but depending on how many show up to mint, this number could be lower. So, for example, if only 782 OGs have minted by the 2 week cut off, we will have released only 800 NFTs at that point and that would be the final supply. IMPORTANT: For OGs that have not minted by the cut off date, you will not be receiving your free Bubblejett Sprinter OG Custom. Sorry! 

OG Role Moving Forward…

First, the OG role is officially CLOSED starting now and will reopen once the mint has concluded. 

From the beginning, our vision for the Old Guard was to have a core group of supporters that acted as the defense line for our brand. As we inevitably will grow, so will our community. That being said, there will always be an opportunity for YOU to become an OG. 

Moving forward, if you are upgraded to OG after the conclusion of our first OG free mint, you will be eligible for your free OG NFT beginning next year. 

Secondary Market
Yes… I would expect that a few will list their NFTs. Anyone is obviously welcome to purchase the Bubblejett Sprinter OG Custom. NOTICE: If you purchase this NFT on a secondary marketplace, this does NOT grant you the OG role in discord.

@everyone

As you all know, we recently launched our highly anticipated (and long-awaited) Bubblejett Sprinter OG Custom. Per our announcement, our OGs have a 2-week window to create their account on our marketplace and mint their free NFT. Once the minting window has run its course, we will close minting and the supply will be set in stone! At the moment, we currently have a total of 646 Bubblejett Custom OGs minted! We have also already reached 100k+ in trading volume on jpg.store!

As for the minting process itself, our OGs had a smooth and quick minting experience with the exception of a few orders. The few issues we encountered were minor and have been addressed by our dev team. Furthermore, our email/Discord verification system grants us the ability to restrict minting access to particular Discord roles. This will serve to eliminate the odds of our website being crashed by bot raids or a flood of buyers. Our marketplace was designed and customized with the community in mind! 

This mint is meaningful to our team and community in so many ways. Not only were we able to give back to our OGs who have continually been supportive, but we were able to put our custom marketplace under the spotlight for the first time. This is a major stepping stone toward the launch of Cornucopias' NFT land sale!

The Mint officially closes on April 25, 2022 at 11:00 AM
